faqs.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faqs.a: Check-in from 12 pm, check-out by 11 am. Arriving early or on a night train? Message us — we adjust when we can.

faqs.q: What ID do I need to check in?
faqs.a: Aadhaar, passport or driving licence — one valid photo ID per adult, as per government rules.
Yes — parking is available at the property. Tell us your vehicle when you message and we will keep a spot ready.

faqs.q: Can I cancel or change my booking?
faqs.a: Yes. Message us as early as you can — direct bookings on WhatsApp carry no cancellation fee.

faqs.q: How do I pay? Can I pay at the hotel?
faqs.a: Cash, UPI and cards are accepted. You pay at the hotel — no advance needed for most bookings.
